claim_audit_results.claim_summary: ~30% of EU territory affected by seasonal water scarcity; climate change intensifies drought and irrigation demand.
Processing tomato chosen as model crop because it is a demanding predictive-irrigation system.
Central research question on forecasting physiologically grounded water stress across seasons/countries/fields.
State-of-the-art critique of retrospective-metric evaluation in agricultural ML.

Objectives verified by named deliverables with due months (D1.1/D1.2 M6 ... D5.2-D5.5 M30).
Decomposition into RQ1-RQ7 and H1-H6, with H3-H6 framed as degradations to be quantified.
Six scientific gaps G1-G6 map one-to-one onto the objectives.
Ambition as six transitions plus a four-stage validation ladder.
Methodological bridge from proximal hyperspectral to Sentinel-2 and physiological (not spectral-proxy) stress definition.
Field Decision Value introduced as final evaluation layer.
Five WPs WP1-WP5 with WP1->WP2->WP3->WP4->WP5 dependency chain.
DrR - Digital Agronomist prototype already exists; FIELDWISE supplies validation/transferability framework.

Strategic differentiation toward transferability and decision value via six transitions and validation ladder.
Project title 'Beyond Prediction Accuracy...'.
Overall methodology is a four-stage transferability validation ladder instantiated as five WPs.

Leakage-safe validation design established in WP1, delivered month 6.
Sensor-domain bridge (resampling, concurrent observation, scale calibration) delivered as transfer library M14.
Prediction layer: temporal features, baselines, RF/XGBoost, Bayesian/hierarchical, calibration, uncertainty (WP3).
Underpinning assumptions stated as six falsifiable hypotheses H1-H6.
FDV established in WP5 selecting models by field-level usefulness; delivered as FDV report M30.
Methodology rests on existing five-year MATE archive and DrR prototype; residual risks scientific.
Objective-to-WP mapping, each closed by named deliverables with due months.
Deliverable titles and due months incl. D1.3 Career Development Plan agreed by month 3.
Five methodological challenges each with a mitigation built into the work plan.
Architecture responds to a prior submission's weakness in heterogeneous spatial/spectral/temporal treatment.
Interdisciplinary approach necessary because the question spans physiology, remote sensing, ML, decision support.
